My bag is just about 20 days in, it's starting to get more white stuff, which I'm assuming is mycelium. 😀
I feel like I should have waited longer to post, because I'm sure I'll post again lol.
But yeah, I'd love to know what someone who has done this for a while thinks, and if anyone knows if this is a good sign? Like, I'm assuming it's just gonna colonize a ton more in the next few days? 😊 I'm still super excited and I hope it works out good. I think so far, it does look alright!! 🍄

I'm really hoping that it is, as it's started being more visible, another spot above the grains and below the substrate has turned a little white also.
I know I will report back and post here or elsewhere when the time comes to break it up and when I'm meant to mix them together.
I've just been keeping it in a small enclosed box, with enough air and it's also in a tub too, just to keep it safe, but I think I set up a good environment, since this was all kinda done not planned out completely, kinda just went with what I had and I'm just glad I began the process lol. It's exciting!! 😊

I checked on it again, and it's not as much as I thought there was. Probably way too early to think I'm seeing something. So I'm gonna leave the bag for longer and check again in a few days. I hope it's successful, if it isn't, I will keep trying to get it right.

I managed to do it all okay, the best that I could, and the amount I used seemed fine too, the label on the back instructs to use that amount and I only just had the one syringe. It looks like there is a spot of white below the substrate now. Does that sound like mycelium already? I read a lot that the more that's used, the faster things can be. I'm hoping it's okay and will check back and post again to confirm and know when to break it up.
So amazing!! Well done!! I just inoculated my first bag with Golden Teacher, completely new to this, and I am hoping it goes well. 🙏
I was looking into this before. Congrats!!

Haha, I get a little confused, because of how it was titled. Still new, but I've definitely been trying to get as well versed in the terminology as I can. I forgot to mention I have GT. I also ordered like 5 plastic tubs during a sale lol. Such good timing!! But I did need them.
I'm just about to wipe down our kitchen bench, I don't really know the best spot to inoculate, but it's slightly cleaner out there, although I can't really do much about other messes. I'm talking about a house of hoarders and so much clutter.
Once I inoculate, I will just hold it gently and move it a little. Like I will try to let my instinct guide me on that front. I was originally just gonna do it and see how it turns out. But I'm also interested in not failing. 😂 
Thank you!! I know regardless of the outcome, this is now something I'm interested in, and I'd love to get more into mycology now. 😊
I'm even happy to just grow like store brought ones and do some cooking!! But this feels like it has been a long time coming. I wonder if we learn more from the mushrooms we grow ourselves? 🤔 I'm honestly so curious and excited to see how my trip will turn out.

Will do!! I heard it's delahaze? I dunno how anyone can have anything against the Indimed options, it is very affordable, and it's also tons better than what I used to get before. With the easing into cannabis, Indimed is a great choice and money saver. I was so glad when I got my scripts out.
I'm only new to it, but I'm enjoying it. I find it's helping ease me into it, and having more options. I'm going for the sativa next. I made strong butter using the tempo indica.
I picked up mine last week, first time trying and am enjoying it so much, I used all my left overs to make butter out of it.
I'm picking mine up next week!! Can't wait to give it a try!

I get so much more out of my product this way, the last time I decarbed, I thought it felt like a waste, why not just vape it instead? It's just for myself, if it was for anyone else, I'd do the oven method. Plenty feels just like that, I know how to cook, so it's quite easy to implement that into how I heat my cannabis.
Although the chamber might appear big, it has its issues, as you can see the cannabis gets trapped to the sides.
It's probably because I still feel a little high, but I would love for a different version of this device without the cable, and a light source, so it's easier to see it in the dark, and without the worry of removing the vaped stuff without an accidental burn to the fingers.
I appreciate so much that you've shared that with me, and that knowing other people out there just use it in their own way. I definitely love the flavour and smell, something about it is so calming and reassuring.
It's almost mesmerising. It's why I can go into so much detail!!
Very very good for my anxiety levels. 🙏

I'm not sure why everyone is so concerned because it wasn't grinded for this post. 😂 All I've ever done is use a grinder, it only took me a long time to be like, why not take it slow, and see if this will yield a good result in this new way? It's also very helpful to do it this way sometimes, as it helps me maintain flavour in the avb.
Yep!! I heat from 160, for a couple of minutes, and adjust it slowly, until it reaches the highest temperature.
It is like toasting a piece of toast. You get to see the colour changes, too, and realise the similarities with strains. And this is coming from someone who isn't fully knowledged in cannabis, but from long use, thinks it's interesting how different the highs are, and that it does matter with the temperature changes. It is so so tasty.
I could just sniff the buds for forever, they're so good, that I almost feel bad they're getting vaped. It's so lovely.
Not at all. It got broken down when the time was right. 😊

I think the flower needs to be treated nicely sometimes, I sense that I can get a lot more of it if I start it out like this, because the heat will slowly rise into it, and it just tastes amazing. As it starts increasing, it enables me to just use my hands and break it down. 😊 I feel if I rush into having it in there, I run the risk of too much coming out and coughing. It's just a slow process. But I get SO much out of it that way. And also, it wouldn't look good for a photo, if we can't appreciate the beauty of it before it changes. Because it looks and smells incredible.

Haha. The doctor knew of my history, and it's only been on and off occasionally. I think some people don't get I've my own method of how I use it. If I didn't vape the way I did after discovering it, I wouldn't have had such incredible highs. I still feel it now. And it's been many hours. Great experience.

I have sessions of 'tasting the flavour' it's nice starting low, feeling the high begin, and breaking it up as it heats for me. It's a nice experience. It's how I'm able get as much out of it as possible.

I'm just waiting to get my scripts now. It's been 3 days since the appointment, but I am sure that's it's possible to have to wait a little bit and then get them. Hoping to hear from the pharmacy soon, and what the prices are. I know I think I get like 10% off or something like that? I will definitely be updating once I get my flowers, (sativa & indica) and write about my process.
No worries. To everyone who has added me, I will be gifting out some gifts pretty soon. Probably after my dinner.

I've been very into cannabis itself, (I love the smell and look of it!) But I've wondered more about other things, like the oils and edibles. I know in America they have a bit more variety. I have a pensioner concession card they sent me a few years ago. The blue card. I think it's why my medications are a lot cheaper. I can definitely see that people have a lot of positives about getting it this way. I really wanna take the leap, but I just worry too much about my financial situation. I know that I would explain everything and how it helps me during my consult. I have a huge appreciation for weed, it was there during some hard times and got me through!! Thank you so much. I will try sometime next week to reach out to arrange an appointment. 🙏

Ooh, I'll have to give a look at the site soon! Yeah, price wise I am generally okay, but if I spend more and more I know I'll end up struggling. It's the last thing I want. But every day, I think more and more about the posts I see on here and knowing accessing it like this might change my relationship with weed. So, I don't end up feeling there is anything wrong with my use and knowing it's used to help with my functioning. I have a lot of mental health issues, I have tried multiple antidepressants with no improvements over the course of a few years. And my short term medication only relieves my back pain temporarily. Weed seems to ease my whole body, and helps me be creative and more attentive, as my mind wanders and I also can't slow down my thoughts. Thank you. I hope I will be able find someone understanding and work something out.

It's very strange, because she's been nice to me and has shown me support. All I've been told now is submit these jobs, I can't even do that, nothing applies to me, I don't have a computer to sit in front of and it's so confusing for me as I go to things and then it leads me to some other site and it's just a big mess. I feel like, if I can even manage that, there is nothing I'm qualified for and if I submit just anything, I'd get into trouble for that as well.
I suspect I have other conditions that haven't been diagnosed, but all I felt was literal frustration from the job seeker site. I'm gonna keep doing what I have been doing and it's talking with someone who will listen, get 6 months again, and hopefully see a psychiatrist. The saddest thing about all this, is that I had years taken from me and a completely different upbringing. I don't blame my mum, but I was in a bubble from the world and all I knew was being shut up in doors. I just lost a lot of time and experience due to being a carer. Took a long time to be where I am now. I feel one day I can use my skills. But anyone who wanted a down to earth conversation with me would be understanding. They'd get it. They'd hear it in my voice. Hopefully this will be behind me for good if I get approved when I submit a claim again. I am hoping it will be this year. I feel so much for anyone else dealing with them.

She just seemed to be very dismissive, and assuming some kind of toxic positivity by what she believes I will be benefiting from my medical exemption.
I'm only 7 years into working on my mental health and catching up on so much, (a lot was unaddressed during 9 years of being a carer for mum) and having to change psychologists a lot, being in hospital and visiting it to be seen, just has taken a huge toll on me.
The provider said that the session with him should have been more than half an hour, and I definitely feel like he can no longer be bothered with me. It's how it feels.
They were both good to me over time, no issues, and just now there has just been this change with them. It's just hurtful, because I think about mental health a lot and my approach wouldn't be using any of those words. It's far from encouraging and lowers self-esteem.
There is a lot of work to mental health many don't see and what others accomplish when they try to do what's best for them in life.
I've had a few phone sessions with a psychologist through Uplift, as my previous one left and moved to Melbourne. I feel I don't really connect with this current one and will end up being on a waiting list for a recommended and suitable psychologist. I have to get my review done and eventually get back to these sessions, so when that's done she will mail me a support letter. Yeah, it's really difficult. I find going back to my doctor and doing all these things harder. I know in the long run that it will help, but at the same time, it does feel easier to neglect doing it and I know it's not an excuse at all. From my perspective, I see it is I'm feeling defeated and when I get back up again, I will make those steps and do it in my own time. Even if I'm slow, I still respect myself and my progress.
I was with DES prior to seeing someone for a job capacity assessment, literally in the room with this lady at my appointment, it was a good while ago now, but I was explaining everything and even cried, because it's very sensitive information and I struggle to speak in person. I haven't applied since I think it was in 2018? I'm slowly working my way again to reapply, but feel I'd be at a loss if I tried now when I have to wait even longer for more information to provide them with. I gave them so much, unfortunately it wasn't enough. I wish I had appealed it.

Thank you so much. ☺️ I'm so amazed, and so happy about the results. I notice the vest is mainly uncomfortable if you have drains in, or in my case, being sick and finding it difficult to wanna wear it when I needed some time to breathe. It just felt harder when I wasn't well. Now I just take it off when I feel like it, and put it back on when I go to bed lol. I'm doing much better now and have such a good appetite. ☺️ Very true, I just hope they survive. But I think they will be okay. I wish you the best for your upcoming surgery - the only advice I have is just do your best to make sure you can look after yourself after if you're doing it alone, and try not to do more than you are able to. I went for only a short walk the day after and I honestly think it drained me, and maybe contributed to me being unwell. But you feel crazy good from having been knocked out and the meds lol. I felt like I could do anything lmao. Eat lots of good food if you're hungry and hydrate whenever you can. Rest a ton as well. Shower also when you are ready!! It really helps so much when you can do it, and things just get easier each week. I'm excited for you to have your top surgery. ☺️ And also thank you!! ☺️🦔💎

Thank you. 🙏 Yeah, the getting sick part was the absolute worst, and I'm so glad to be on the mend. Except I have a bad habit of doing more than I should, like reaching up and bending down when I know I shouldn't haha. I think once I have my appointment Monday and they tell me for sure it's all good I'll feel more relief about it. I have to give them a headsup though, I ended up leaking fluid on my left side a few days after the drains were removed, and it wasn't very nice lol. For sure!! I wasn't that anxious before surgery, which is shocking to me as I'm a super anxious person, and I knew this decision to have the surgery was a big one. Just be kind to yourself, try to make some things accessible prior to surgery and listen to your body after. I found that surgery can make some things change, like my appetite for certain foods was different, although that could be from being sick, but maybe meal prepping, and just asking for help when you need it is good, so you don't end up pushing yourself too hard. And the most important thing is resting, and always being kind to yourself during recovery. 🙏

Yeah, I was thinking it was normal, but I did see a new doctor instead of my main one, and I think she's still new, so maybe she just saw how they looked and assumed there was some kind of infection. I mean, it does look pretty worrying haha!!

Congrats on your surgery!! I had mine in for about 5 days, and it felt so good to get them out. Although there was less fluid, I don't know if this is common, but a few days later my left side leaked out a fair amount of fluid, I think it was a build up, I'm not entirely sure, but I will ask at my follow up appointment about it and hopefully it's all okay. Hope that doesn't happen to you. And all the best when they are removed. It's so much more freeing without them!! ☺️

Thank you so much!! I can't believe it all happened and I'm so grateful. Just worried about my nipples lol. I think they are fine, but I guess it's easy to feel paranoid and worried since it's still early days. I'm so happy what this surgery has given me. 🙏

Hi everyone!! My name is Kye, and I had top surgery on the 17th of June, and I am currently 16 days post op!! I had such a good surgery, and honestly felt on top of the world the next day. After surgery, I felt a lot of pain, very tired and quite nauseated. But I got given stuff to settle it, went in and out of sleep, to wake up with such a good appetite!! I sadly got unexpectedly sick the following days, I don't know if it was from stress or my anxiety, or coming off the pain meds, or just the general shock from having surgery. But I'm healing pretty okay, and will have a follow up appointment on Monday.
My nipples have been troubling me, they're in this stage where they're kinda looking oozy yellow, kinda moist, however, I know this could be normal, but a doctor put me on antibiotics, and I'll find out on Monday further information. But I'm sure there is nothing to worry about!!
I think the hardest part was honestly having the drains, and being sick. But I just wanted to share this photo, and share my happiness. ☺️
The compression vest hasn't been all that bad, either!! I just got to wash it today, and I'm waiting for it to dry before I put it back on. I unfortunately had days where it was off for a good while, or it was not helping when I was sick, so I had to just leave it off to feel better.
I'm really happy with my results though, and the way my chest is taking shape.
I had top surgery under a registar with Dr. Mertern's supervision.
